question: Should `openclaw/plugin-sdk/reply-payload` publicly guarantee the generic tool-progress kind and predicate for third-party producers and channels?
rationale: The bundled Codex-to-Slack path needs a legal plugin boundary, but exposing this exact semantic as a durable third-party API requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve the generic contract
options.body: Keep the exports, document their transient-only semantics, and add focused direct contract coverage before merge.

options.title: Use an existing semantic
options.body: Extend a canonical reply-status contract instead if maintainers do not want a distinct public progress API.

recommendation.title: Approve the generic contract
recommendation.body: Keep the exports, document their transient-only semantics, and add focused direct contract coverage before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work spans the Slack delivery and plugin-facing presentation boundaries involved in this decision.
